text:
A radioactive element undergoes α-decay.
Which statement is not correct?
A
A different element is formed.
B
Radiation is emitted from the nucleus.
C
The decay is a random process.
D
The number of particles in the nucleus stays the same.

options.label: B
options.text: Radiation is emitted from the nucleus.

options.label: C
options.text: The decay is a random process.

options.label: D
options.text: The number of particles in the nucleus stays the same.
